name: Banasura Peak

gallery.attribution: Dr. Raju Kasambe, CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rusty-tailed_Flycatcher_Muscicapa_ruficauda_Banasura_Hill_Kerala_DSC_8783_(1).jpg

highlights: Banasura Hill is situated in Padinjarathara and it is one of the tallest mountains in the Western Ghats of the Wayanad district, Kerala, India. The hill is named after Banasura, a mythical character of Indian legends. It is one of the highest peaks exceeding 2,000m between Nilgiris and Himalayas after Chembra Peak.
